description: Lists the Guggach apartments that are available for a date range and returns the exact price for that stay (same calculation as the booking page: nightly or monthly basis). If the user has not given concrete check-in/check-out dates and a party size, ask them for these first. Returns the available apartments with their total price for the stay and a ready-to-use booking link, or an explanation if nothing is available — in that case always pass the returned hint to the user and offer to check other dates.

from.description: Check-in date in YYYY-MM-DD format (today or later).

locale.description: Language for the response and prices. Defaults to "de".

to.description: Check-out date in YYYY-MM-DD format (after the check-in date).

name: check-availability
title: Check apartment availability and price
